convert_flux_ipadapter_checkpoint: convert a Flux XLabs IP-Adapter checkpoint to Diffusers format and save as safetensors
load_original_checkpoint: load a checkpoint from a HuggingFace Hub repo or local safetensors file path
run_conversion_cli: run the CLI script to convert a Flux IP-Adapter checkpoint using repo id and output path
save_clip_vision_encoder: download and save a pretrained CLIP vision model alongside the converted IP-Adapter weights
convert_state_dict_keys: remap XLabs IP-Adapter state dict keys to Diffusers naming convention for image proj and transformer blocks
